question: How can different powers draw in other powers during worship?
premises: Some powers are unlimited while others are limited.
Powers can draw in other powers.
This occurs according to the principle of nearness and distance.
inference: Therefore the scope of a contemplated power depends on whether it is limited or unlimited and on its relative nearness.
uncertainties: The compound at the end is dense; the intended logical principle is inferred from the surrounding doctrine.
plain_english: In that context, some power may be unlimited, or there may be limited powers; each can draw in others according to the principle of nearness and distance.
